messages:
Maria Chen: heads-up — us-west-2 pack density dipped to ~0.46 after yesterday's autoscaler tuning, fragmentation spiked. seeing a lot of 0.25–1h low-p50 jobs that don't pack well :thinking:
Kevin Patel: do you have the breakdown by job size? small jobs are the usual culprit but curious if it's new workloads
Maria Chen: attaching quick metrics snippet and the histogram we pulled: small_jobs_pct=38%, avg_slot_util=0.62, pack_density=0.46, cold_evictions=12/day. link: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/pack-density
Zach R: sounds like fairshare weights are letting small, bursty tenants win short slots — increases fragmentation. We could try: (1) tighten small-job bin threshold (2) bump minimum slice to 2gpus for best-efficiency classes (3) temporary reserve pool for latencies
Ana Gomez: agree. Also Q2 marketing + 3 enterprise pilots -> forecasted burst mid-Apr. That increases small interactive jobs. Forecast model shows +18% small-job volume for 4 weeks.
Priya Das: cost note: unit GPU hours rose ~12% last week vs baseline due to lower fill. Need to balance fairness w/ cost.
Kevin Patel: proposal: tune scheduler fairshare alpha from 0.6 -> 0.5 for bursty classes and add a pack_decay window of 300s. Try in ap-south canary first.
Zach R: +1 for pack_decay. Also add a fragmentation penalty metric so long-run low-density hosts get favored for consolidation. Pseudocode:
```
scheduler {
  fairshare_alpha: 0.5
  small_job_threshold_secs: 3600
  min_slice_gpus[class:high_efficiency] = 2
  pack_decay_seconds = 300
  fragmentation_penalty = host_free_slots * 0.8
}
```
Maria Chen: can we do a quick sim on last 7d trace before rolling? want to avoid thrash. If sim shows >5% unit-cost improvement, we can canary.
sre-bot: alert: pack_density_us-west-2 < 0.5 (1765432122) — raised automated ticket #INF-4873
Priya Das: also note eviction budget needs to be clear — if we consolidate aggressively during peak, latency-sensitive tenants might suffer. propose eviction_budget=10% for canary
Ana Gomez: timeline: run sim today, canary in ap-south next Tue (low traffic), monitor p50/p95 latency & unit-cost. If metrics look good, roll to us-west-2 Wed night with 2h rollback window.
Kevin Patel: i'll prepare canary config and sim harness, pinging infra-oncall for deployment window. @Zach can you add the fragmentation penalty to the sim?
Zach R: on it. will post sim results by EOD. :thumbsup:
Maria Chen: thanks team. if sim flags any regression, let's pause and iterate. otherwise we'll aim for ap-south canary next week.
